text:
alan_presales: Quick heads-up — MedLink wants to run a 2-week POC. Requirement: EU-only data residency + vendor/subproc list + routing policy that never leaves EU region. Also need estimate of any pricing delta for pinned EU capacity. Who can help compile checklist?
sara_sales: I can start pricing. Do we have a standard uplift % for region-pin/residency?
omar_eng: For technical: we need to know whether they need control-plane in EU too or just data path. If control plane can be outside EU, routing is simpler.
nina_security: MedLink sent their security questionnaire — they will require subproc attestations and a copy of our subprocessor inventory + DPA excerpt. I'll need a confirmed list of subs used for that EU region.
lina_ops: Ops note: private routing for tenant pinning requires VPC peering or PrivateLink in eu-west-1; timeline is ~3 business days to arrange peering + certs if customer provides CIDR. Also we need to verify KMS key locality if they want BYOK.
sara_sales: Pricing: preliminary assumption is +15% for reserved EU-dedicated capacity (covers capacity pin + compliance overhead). If BYOK or HSM involved, add one-time setup fee. I'll draft a quote.
omar_eng: Routing nuance: we have two compatible modes — "regional pin" (requests always routed to eu cluster) and "geofence+failover" (prefer eu but failover to global if capacity). MedLink says "never leaves EU" so must be strict regional pin. That affects capacity planning.
alan_presales: They explicitly said: "no cross-border egress under any circumstances". So strict pin it is. Also they asked for list of subprocessors handling networking, telemetry, and observability.
nina_security: Current EU subprocessors: aws-eu (ec2, rds), cloudwatch-eu (telemetry), desk-support-eu (support), kms-eu (if using managed). I will pull our canonical inventory and export redacted attestation.
lina_ops: Ops checklist I need: customer CIDR, desired failover policy (none), BYOK? yes/no, SLAs for POC, contact for peering (ops@medlink). Once we have that we can open a ticket for network.
sara_sales: @nina_security can you confirm whether cloudwatch metrics are replicated to US? We need to guarantee telemetry stays in EU for this POC.
nina_security: Currently our telemetry pipeline for hosted has a EU-only path option for enterprise tenants — we can enable it, but must toggle ingestion endpoint to eu-collector. I'll attach config snippet:```yaml
telemetry:
  collector_endpoint: https://eu-collector.redwood.ai
  region_replicas: none
```
sara_sales: Great. Include that in the attestation note. Also adding: pricing delta estimate + ops lead time into the sales doc.
omar_eng: One more technical: quantization/quant profiles that reduce memory might let us pack more tenants into the EU pool, but for a POC we should reserve dedicated capacity to avoid noisy neighbors. Recommendation: reserve 1x T4-equivalent pool for the two-week test.
alan_presales: OK action items: 1) nina export subproc + attestation and confirm telemetry path stays EU. 2) lina collect network contact + CIDR + BYOK flag and open peering ticket. 3) sara produce quote with +15% baseline + BYOK fees + 1x reserved EU instance rec. 4) omar confirm runtime config & confirm that model variants fallback is disabled (no cross-border).
reminder-bot: Don’t forget to attach the DPA excerpt — https://redwood.internal/docs/dpa-excerpt (internal) :memo:
sara_sales: I'll have the quote and a short POC SOW by EOD tomorrow.
nina_security: Pulling inventory now, will post redacted list and a short attestation doc by EOD.
lina_ops: I'll ping ops on the peering ticket and update with ETA in this thread.
omar_eng: I'll validate the runtime flags and share the config we will use for strict regional routing.
alan_presales: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and send to MedLink once we have docs. :thumbsup:
